MWI.note: Nothing on AI rules or harms.
Only an agriculture-sector AI tool, which is not general administration.

facts.fact: Nation Online reports the Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Irrigation has piloted the Malawi Digital Plant Health Services project since 2022, built around the AI-powered PlantVillage app.

Nation Online reports lead farmers have used the AI PlantVillage app since 2023 to photograph crops and get written pest advisories, with data monitored by government experts through an AI observatory at the Department of Agriculture Extension Services and the Dedza district office.

MWI.note: PlantVillage is not stated to be developed or hosted in Malawi.
Mentions only the 2025 National Census of Agriculture, an agricultural census.
